richiami.rimedio: All the 255/60R18 112V Cooper Zeon 4XS Sport Tyres that were produced during week 36 of 2022 (DOT case 3622) and week 37 of 2022 (DOT code 3722) must be exchanged.

richiami.difetto: Hernias or tears may develop on the shoulder of the tyre due to variations in production which may result in an over-thickness of the stuffing on the rod, or from a problem with the end of the overlapping layers due to the specifications of the width of the layers, as air bubbles may form during manufacture.This could lead to a loss of inflation pressure and a potential failure of the tyre, which may interfere with the steering or driving of the vehicle, increasing the risk of accident. The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 25/03/2021

richiami.difetto: Following endurance testing it has been established that separation of the breaker to casing ply may occur. This can be identified by a bulge in the tread area however if the separation is not identified then loss of air may result.  This could affect control of the vehicle and in extreme cases result in a collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected tyres and replace them with quality assured replacements.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that the subject tyres have failed to comply with the requirements of 49CFR 571.139 S6.3.2 (a) in that the test tyre developed a bulge in the lower sidewall on the whitewall side which indicates the presence of a separation between the two lower sidewall components. Should this go undetected loss of inflation medium may occur which can result in a loss of directional control.

richiami.rimedio: Owners of the recall subject tyres will be contacted; and the tyres replaced.

richiami.rimedio: Customers will be contacted and tyres replaced free of charge.
